GPT-6.2 Astra users now hit limits 40% faster after OpenAI patched a pricing error
items.excerpt: OpenAI says a billing bug gave GPT-6.2 users incorrect discounts. After the fix, Astra and Sol users hit their limits 40 and 25 percent faster than last week. As an apology, subscribers get an extra reset, and business users get free Fast Mode through year-end. OpenAI is also testing a Chat and Work mode merger. items.title: Former OpenAI researcher says the Riemann proof matters less than the fact that an AI system can produce it
items.excerpt: Complexity theorist and former OpenAI researcher Scott Aaronson argues that AI's recent math breakthroughs matter far beyond academia. The possible consequences, he writes, range from reshaping the global economy to threatening all life on Earth. He's also "virtually certain" that AI labs are sitting on "one or more bombshells" in cryptography. items.title: Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache
items.excerpt: Tencent open-sourced DFly2, a speculative decoding drafter for sparse-attention LLMs. Each draft layer reuses the target's KV cache and top-k indexer picks, adding no draft KV memory and lifting 64K serving throughput by up to 81%. The post Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache appeared first on MarkTechPost .
